display_title: Fated to Be With My Childhood Friend
description:
“What the hell, why is everything about you so big—it’s annoying!” She loved volleyball, but thanks to her genetics (and her small figure), she was always stuck as a benchwarmer. Meanwhile, her tall, genius childhood friend constantly got under her skin. Out of frustration, she decided to give him a taste of his own medicine… “The responsibility you were talking about… does it mean this?” Unavoidably, she ended up doing it with her childhood friend?!
